Personal information such as addresses, names, and phone numbers is handled only within the scope necessary for delivery operations.
When using Google Maps or future ZENRIN API services, the respective terms of service apply.
Tap a question to reveal the answer
Contact us via the side menu → "User Feedback".\nEmail: Hakobun.support@gmail.com
How do I register a package?

Tap the "Register" button at the top right of the Home screen, or go to the side menu → "Register Package".

There are three methods:
① Enter address manually
② Scan a shipping label with your camera (OCR)
③ Speak the address using voice input

After registering, a pin will appear on the Home map.
How many packages can I register per day?

The Free plan (including the 1-month trial) allows up to 5 packages per day.

The Premium plan (¥980/month) has no registration limit.

When you reach the limit, a plan upgrade prompt will appear when you tap the register button.
How do I update a delivery status?
Tap a pin on the Home map, or tap a card in the delivery list to open the detail screen.\n\nYou can change the status to "Delivered," "Absent," "Redeliver," or "Return to Office."
The map pin is not in the right location

Pin accuracy depends on geocoding (address-to-coordinates conversion).\n\nIn the package registration screen, long-press the pin on the map at the bottom and drag it to the correct position. The adjusted location will be saved.
How do I use regular routes (pickup)?

Go to the side menu → "Pickup / Regular Routes" to bulk-load pre-registered routes (A–D) into today\'s delivery list.\n\nRoutes can be added and edited in the "Route Management" section on the same screen.
The OCR reading of the shipping label was inaccurate

Try the following:

· Shoot in a well-lit area
· Make sure the entire label fits within the frame
· Hold the phone steady with both hands
· Check for smudges, folds, or reflections

Each field can be corrected manually after OCR. Accuracy depends on lighting and print quality.
Voice input is not being recognized

Please check:

· Microphone permission is granted to the app (Settings → Apps → HAKOBUN → Permissions)
· Speak in a quiet environment
· Speak the address slowly and clearly

Voice recognition uses the Google Speech Recognition engine.

Please check:

① Notifications are enabled in the app (Notices → Settings → Notifications)
② Android Settings → Apps → HAKOBUN → Notifications is set to "Allow"
③ Battery saver mode is not restricting background activity

If the problem persists, tap "Reschedule alarms."
How do I turn off notifications?
In the app: side menu → Notices → Settings → toggle Notifications to OFF.\n\nYou can also disable them via Android Settings → Apps → HAKOBUN → Notifications.
When does my free trial end?

The free trial lasts 30 days from the date you registered.

Check the remaining days on your User Account screen (side menu → User Account).

Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid being charged.
How do I cancel my subscription?

Go to Google Play Store → Account icon → "Subscriptions" → HAKOBUN → "Cancel subscription."\n\nYou can continue using the app until the end of the current billing period. In-app cancellation is coming soon.

Please check your payment method in Google Play.

Google Play Store → Account → Payments & subscriptions → Payment methods

Expired cards or insufficient funds are common causes. Please refer to Google Play support as well.

All data is stored in encrypted storage on your device.

No data is sent to external servers or synced to the cloud. Uninstalling the app will delete all data.

We recommend exporting important data using the Backup feature (side menu → Backup).
Can I transfer data to a new device?

Automatic data transfer is not currently supported.

Before switching devices, export your data using the Backup feature and import it on your new device.

Import: side menu → Backup → "Restore."
The app is slow or crashing

Try the following:

① Fully close and restart the app
② Restart your device
③ Update the app to the latest version (check Google Play Store)
④ If many packages are registered, use "End of Day" to reset

If the problem persists, please contact us.
I want to report a bug or suggest an improvement
Send feedback via the side menu → Notices → "User Feedback."\n\nPlease include specific details (steps to reproduce, device model, Android version) for a faster response.

Email: Hakobun.support@gmail.com

When contacting us, please provide:
· Device model and Android version
· App version
· Steps to reproduce the issue

We respond during business hours (Mon–Fri, 10:00–18:00 JST).
HAKOBUN Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
Please read the following terms before using this app. By starting to use the app, you agree to these terms.

HAKOBUN ("the App") is a delivery management support application designed to improve the efficiency of delivery drivers. It provides features such as package registration, route management, delivery status tracking, and OCR address reading from shipping labels.\n\nThe App is an operational support tool. Compliance with applicable laws, safe driving, and adherence to your delivery company\'s regulations are solely the responsibility of the user.

The App is intended for users aged 18 and over who are engaged in delivery operations or act as operations managers.\n\nA Google account may be required to use certain features. Registration with false information is prohibited.

[Free Trial]
A 1-month free trial is provided upon first registration. All features are available during the trial period. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, you will automatically be moved to the paid plan.

[Paid Plan (Premium)]
Price: ¥980 / month (tax included)
Billing: Monthly auto-renewal via Google Play
Cancellation: Cancel anytime from "Subscriptions" in the Google Play Store. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.

[Refund Policy]
Refunds follow Google Play's refund policy. For cancellations within 48 hours of purchase, please apply through Google Play.

[Price Changes]
You will be notified at least 30 days in advance of any price changes via in-app notice or email.
Article 4 – Data Collected and How It Is Used

■ Location (GPS)
Purpose: Navigation to delivery destinations, current location display, route optimization
Collection: Only while the app is in use (no background collection)

■ Camera / Images
Purpose: Automatic address entry via OCR of shipping labels
Storage: On-device only (no cloud upload)

■ Voice (Microphone)
Purpose: Transcription of addresses and notes via voice input
Storage: On-device only

■ Input Data (name, address, phone, email)
Purpose: Delivery management and driver profile setup
Storage: Encrypted on-device storage (AES-256-GCM)
External transmission: None

■ Google Maps Platform
Used for map display, navigation, and address geocoding. Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) applies.

■ Google Play Billing
Used for subscription payments. Payment information is managed by Google; the App does not store it.

■ Google ML Kit (Text Recognition)
OCR is performed on-device only; no data is sent to external servers.

■ Google Location Services
Used for GPS access.

Personal and operational data you enter is stored in encrypted on-device storage (Android EncryptedSharedPreferences / AES-256-GCM).

No data is transmitted to external servers or synced to the cloud. Uninstalling the App will remove all data from the device.

If you use the Backup feature, you are responsible for managing the exported data.

The following activities are prohibited:

· Reverse-engineering, tampering with, or redistributing the App
· Entering or using another person's personal information without consent
· Using the App for any purpose that violates applicable law
· Placing excessive load on the App's servers or infrastructure
· Fraudulent registration or misuse to circumvent billing

The App is provided "as is." The operator is not responsible for:

· Accuracy of map information or route guidance (always follow road signs and traffic laws)
· Accuracy of OCR results
· Data loss due to app bugs or communication failures
· Outages or specification changes by third-party services
· Business losses or delivery errors

Always verify important delivery information yourself.

These terms may be updated without prior notice. You will be notified of significant changes via in-app notification or email. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
